name: com.baziness.sdk
description: Baziness platform for Unity games: Baziness pages (sign-in, profile, rewards) in a built-in web view (gree unity-webview, bundled), Gita coin balance, link-code sign-in from other games, install attribution, device info and player analytics. Your game server uses the Baziness server SDK.

samples.description: A MonoBehaviour that starts the SDK, shows the balance and opens the reward page.
